kind: host dialog submission route lifetime regression
coverage: Mounted dialog already dismissed by explicit discard: old merge/recovery/backup submit delegates are blocked; primary facts, replacement/protection counts and file saves remain unchanged.
After an authorized delayed save, merge/recovery/backup completion checks the captured original route and leaves a later unrelated page open.
Readable JSON and CSV answers are single-use, reject old confirmation after cancellation, and check the original data page after the answer awaits; double confirmation saves only once.

Permanent remote account deletion uses the actual screen/controller, temporary SQLite, and controlled HttpClient: cancellation and leaving produce no DELETE and preserve active settings/facts; valid double-click intent sends exactly one DELETE.

First sync uses the actual SyncEngine and temporary SQLite with controlled opaque relay: cancellation/leaving produces zero uploaded operations and zero sync protections; valid double confirmation uploads once and creates exactly one protection while preserving business facts.
Idle data export and sync enrollment/reauthorization callbacks cannot begin dialogs or requests after their original page has left.
An already authorized file-open result returned after leaving cannot open the password or restore preview, replace facts, or create protection.
Device picker rejects a stale revoke answer after Close and keeps the parent open; archive/information Close callbacks check their own route.
Existing first-frame busy protection, failed draft/retry, strict import and explicit legacy-text-compatible restore remain covered by the related tests.
boundaries: Synthetic host widget/real temporary SQLite/controlled HTTP evidence; no real server, device or APK claim.
Authorized in-flight commits keep their existing semantics; ordinary idle actions and continuation dialogs require their original route.
Complete proof and raw diagnostics remain private outside the repository; root full regression/build follows.
